Static landing pages with plain 3-column cards are obsolete. Explore the newest wave of award-winning websites featuring kinetic typography, smooth inertial scroll physics, and interactive SVG shaders.

Tailored for designers, visual artists, and creative professionals, Next-Gen Motion & Web Design enhances design precision, speeds up production-grade asset generation, and ensures consistent visual polish.

Key Features:
• Study the curated website showcase for interaction inspiration.
• Implement custom scroll physics using Framer Motion or GSAP.
• Keep interactions subtle and responsive across both mobile and desktop.
• Complete React component with fluid parallax card scrolling and responsive breakpoints.
